meta.purpose: TC-2254 golden vectors for the tinycloud.email-held/v1 acquisition wire (v2)
meta.generatedBy: Throwaway native Rust test (default features, fixture mailbox, in-memory backend) that calls the real witness router() handlers; removed afterwards (v2 re-run after review 05b24021). Every refusal listed was asserted to return the recorded status and code.
meta.crossChecks: sdkCrossCheck was produced by running the js-sdk sources (sdk-core, web-sdk account-holder, node-sdk transport) read-only against these vectors with bun.
meta.variableValues: requestId, challengeNonce, jti, issuedAt/expiresAt, correlationId, OTP, salts and the credential bytes differ per run. Compare shape, not bytes, except in descriptor, holderProof.fixed and the digests, which are deterministic.
meta.testIssuer: Test issuer is Ed25519 seed [7;32] with did:web:issuer.credentials.org#controller. The production key is different; the SDK pins it as EMAIL_PROOF_PINS.issuerX.
meta.verifierSecret: meta.verifier is a throwaway bearer value used in the in-memory test only.
notExercised: ISSUANCE_REPLAYED (mod.rs:2470), REQUEST_REPLAYED (mod.rs:2351) and RESULT_REPLAYED (mod.rs:2534), all 409: produced only by a concurrent save conflict; not reproducible without a race. [INFERENCE: body shape equals the other 409 bodies]
ISSUER_UNREADY from entropy, storage or signing failure (mod.rs:3663 unavailable()): only the issuer-mismatch route at issue is exercised (refusals: issue_issuer_unready).
HTTP 404/405/413 from axum routing and default body limit: no ProtocolError body. [INFERENCE: axum 0.8 defaults, 2 MiB body limit]
Cookie authentication (oc_acquisition_<id>): the SDK uses the Bearer verifier only.
meta.v2Changes: requirement now uses maxAgeSeconds 31536000 (SPEC:230): requirementDigest Q_dnVOBsX_7fRjuzLPtCmDe_SKPiXW0Sxv0zSPb_Jd4; the earlier KH3gIa87AL7C6_Xj0kn-mCBS70GPewc47si73qNK3YA is the 3600 value and must not be pinned. holderProof.fixed re-signed over the new binding. Added witnessDefectU9, refusals create_inputs_not_object, create_holder_did_not_string, create_invalid_holder_u9_eip55_without_lowercase_letter, stateAfterNoticeFailureBeforeRetry, productionCatalogObserved.heldEntry now includes the descriptor body.

meta.v21Changes: W1 ruling (Naomi): the witness defect is fixed at the root by OC PR #205; the SDK must accept such accounts. The U9 refusal moved out of `refusals` (92 -> 91) into `historical`; `witnessDefectU9` became `historical.witnessDefectW1AtAc95464e`; `acceptanceW1` added (valid only at or after 1aed0bab). All other vectors are unchanged (recorded at ac95464e; `credentials/mod.rs` is identical at 1aed0bab, only `held_email.rs` and tests changed in the credentials module).
meta.v22Changes: v2.2: acceptanceW1.fromLowercase is now the complete lowercase-form flow (plus fromLowercaseSigningInputHex, fromLowercaseEip191Keccak256, fromLowercaseSignature); new top-level section v22 holds SDK-side reproductions for C1 (strict held read), the C2 clock-skew rule and the C3 S16 prototype. No other vector changed.
meta.v23Changes: v2.3: new top-level section v23 (server-time derivation, clock-skew matrix with pre-flight and post-issue outcomes, clock-jump scenarios, address-handling expectations, decided pins, CLIENT_CLOCK_SKEW name register). No recorded exchange changed.
meta.v24Changes: v2.4: amended v23 (the fast-clock row, the name register now lists MESSAGES and the error-table comment); new section v24 (fast-clock pending deadline, CLIENT_CLOCK_SKEW placement and default message, PR #205 merge record, confirm3 native results). No recorded exchange changed.

historical.status: HISTORICAL. Recorded at witness ac95464e before OC PR #205. NOT an SDK expectation: a witness at or after the #205 fix accepts this account (see acceptanceW1). Do not use these exchanges as SDK test expectations.

witnessDefectW1AtAc95464e.note: EIP-55 DID refused at create; lowercase DID accepted and stored as the all-uppercase EIP-55 form; challenge reserves a send then fails 503 ISSUER_UNREADY with no mail; the send is spent.

acceptanceW1.status: ACCEPTANCE vector. Valid only against a witness at or after OC PR #205 head 1aed0babd3395567e131c2dd065d692e1cea3523 (the `HeldAccount::parse` fix). Never run it against a witness before the fix: that witness answers 400 INVALID_HOLDER at create (EIP-55 form) or 503 ISSUER_UNREADY at challenge (lowercase form), see `historical`.
acceptanceW1.howSdkTestsUseIt: Replay `fromEip55` and `fromLowercase` in full against a stub that follows the fixed rule (accept a hex body that has any uppercase letter iff it equals the EIP-55 checksum form; store and echo the EIP-55 form; challenge and issue succeed). Assert: the SDK accepts the account, sends the EIP-55 form (the SDK signer returns it for either input form), signs with kid `<EIP-55 DID>#blockchainAccountId`, and the held verifier accepts the result. Also replay `stillRefused` (valid on both old and fixed witnesses). Never point these tests at a deployed witness before the fix is merged and verified.

clockSkewRule.rule: iatMs = Date.parse(result.validity.issuedAt); clientMs = now().getTime(); if iatMs - clientMs > 300000 refuse VERIFICATION_FAILED; else verifyAt = new Date(max(clientMs, iatMs)); verifyHeldEmailCredential and storeHeldCredential both get now = verifyAt
clockSkewRule.reviewObservationOnLiteralContract: review 1d24147f, sdk-lit with now skewed: -0.02/-0.05/-1/-4 min CREDENTIAL_INVALID after signing (nbf = iat, credential.ts:155); -6 min SESSION_INVALID (S11(a) compared binding.expiresAt with the min(server, client+15min) pending value, email-proof.ts:367); both after a code mail

clockSkewBound.positiveMeans: server time minus client time (client slow)
clockSkewBound.preflight: serverNowMs = Date.parse(created.expiresAt) - 600000; refuse CLIENT_CLOCK_SKEW if serverNowMs - clientMs > 300000
clockSkewBound.postIssue: refuse VERIFICATION_FAILED if iatMs - clientMs > 300000, else verifyAt = max(clientMs, iatMs)
clockSkewBound.exactBehaviour: s <= 300 s: both pass always; s >= 301 s: pre-flight refuses always; 300 < s < 301: truncation band, either stage may refuse
clockSkewBound.fastClients: never refused: with the held pending deadline measured on the client clock (v24.fastClock)
